verdict.rationale: Opting out of AI model training is a fair privacy question for an AI app builder like Lovable, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-usage control, or a no-training policy. Enterprise features such as audit logs and regional code hosting are adjacent controls, not training prevention, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
